title: BA1/1347/2024 of SANTOSH RAM Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
First Bail Application No.1347 of 2024
Santosh Ram ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Rahul Adhikari and Ankit Maini, Advocates for the
applicant.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
The applicant is in judicial custody in FIR No.
471 of 2023, dated 18.11.2023, under Section 420 IPC,
Police Station Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar. He
has sought his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, Aadesh Kumar, the
brother of the informant was dismissed from CRPF. The
applicant was his friend. He assured the informant that if
`25 Lakhs is spent, Aadesh Kumar would be reinstated in
the service and under that assurance, he took `32 Lakhs
on different occasions.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that it is a false case; Aadesh Kumar was drug

2
addict; he was suspended from CRPF; he was staying
with the applicant; the applicant has spent a lot of money
on him, in view thereof, the money was transferred in his
account. He would submit that it is highly unbelievable
that if `32 Lakhs were to be deposited in the account of
the applicant for reinstating the services of the brother of
the informant, it would be deposited on multiple
occasions for more than 150 times. He has referred to
Annexure No.6 to the counter affidavit, which reveals that
even on some date `500 was deposited in the account of
the applicant. It is also argued that charge-sheet has
already filed and no purpose would be served if the
applicant kept in custody.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that on
different occasions, the applicant took `32 Lakhs from the
informant so as to reinstate the services of her brother.
He admits that the charge-sheet has been filed in the
case.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view
that this is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to
be enlarged on bail.
7. The bail application is allowed.

3
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of
the court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 28.08.2024
Sanjay
